function.name: psych_research_get_preference
function.description: Gathers research data on public preference between two options, based on societal category.

category.description: The societal category the preference data is about. E.g. reading, transportation, food

option_one.description: The first option people could prefer.

option_two.description: The second option people could prefer.

demographic.description: Specific demographic of society to narrow down the research.
